mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP growth declined over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it indicates a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate is above 2% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% within a month, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two consecutive months signals a strong demand environment, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where housing starts increased by more than 5% over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and industrial production is increasing, it signals a strong supply-side environment, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during economic expansions.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP growth is positive and industrial production is increasing.
